column1: # Outlander (non-PHEV) service 21 signal definitions used by PHEV Link.

# Changes: a subset only (no signals that need a diagnostic session, no diesel/turbo-only or
# 4th-generation signals); converted from JSON to this table; new ids, names and groups; poll intervals added.

# those terms. The rest of PHEV Link is not covered by this licence.
# Columns (tab-separated): group, id, ecu, pid (hex, request 21 <pid>), bit offset after "61 <pid>",
# bit length, mul, div, add (value = raw * mul / div + add), unit, min, max, poll seconds, flag (1 = on/off bit),
# verified (MY2011 = OBDb marks it verified for model year 2011, no = unverified), OBDb id, name.
